description: Generate all three output files in one shot: TOKENCAP.md (main snapshot), TOKENCAP_GRAPH.md (project dependency graph), and TOKENCAP_MEMORY.md (developer context memory).

options.description: Context profile: compact, balanced, deep, gpt-4o, claude-3-5-sonnet, gemini-1.5-flash, gemini-1.5-pro, llama-3-8b
Maximum number of files to include

description: Generate TOKENCAP_GRAPH.md — a dependency graph of your JS/TS project. Scans all source files, resolves imports and exports, and classifies each file as a route, component, service, API, database model, or config.
Generate TOKENCAP_MEMORY.md from your .tokencap-notes.md file combined with live Git context. Auto-creates the notes file from a template if it doesn't exist yet.
Start a background watcher that regenerates all snapshot files automatically whenever a file changes. Powered by chokidar with configurable debounce.

options.description: Milliseconds to wait after a change before regenerating. Default: 30000

description: Create a default .tokencap.json configuration file in your project root. Safe — will not overwrite an existing config unless you pass --force.
Print the fully resolved configuration as JSON — showing the merged result of defaults, profile overrides, .tokencap.json, and any CLI flags. Useful for debugging your setup.
